info.title: Medynium API
info.description: Governed Patient 360 and clinical agent on Snowflake. Decision support on synthetic data only. Errors use {error, message}. Sessions use HttpOnly cookies; state-changing requests need the X-Medynium-Client: web header.

get.description: Public liveness. Reports nothing about configuration.
Admin only: Snowflake, warehouse state, Cortex objects and audit-write status.

post.description:
Start a session and set the `med_access` and `med_refresh` cookies.

When email codes are required (LOGIN_OTP_ENABLED) no session starts yet: an `OtpChallenge` comes back and the
client finishes with `POST /auth/login/verify`.
Finish a sign-in with the six-digit code that was emailed. Sets the auth cookies.
Public. Emails a one-time reset link when the address belongs to an active account. Always 204.
Rotate both cookies using the refresh cookie. A reused refresh token revokes the session.
Mobile only: rotate the bearer tokens. Same rotation and reuse detection as the cookie refresh.
Revoke the session and clear the cookies. Safe to call when already signed out.

get.description: The signed-in user, their role and what they may do.

post.description: Change your password. Other sessions are revoked.

get.description: Public. Who an invitation or reset link is for.

post.description: Public. Set a password and activate the account (or complete a password reset).

get.description: Worklist with change flags, recent lab and medication changes, utilisation. No AI call.
Briefing of recent changes, on request only (A-13). Rules over the caller's own data, no model call.

The caller's entitled patients, filtered and sorted over all of them before the page is cut.

`q` searches name, id or diagnosis; `changed` keeps only flagged patients; `flag` narrows to one kind of change.

post.description:
Register a patient. The registering doctor is entitled to them at once. A same-name, same-birth-date patient
already on the doctor's list is a 409 until `confirm_duplicate` is set.

get.description: A note is returned as plain text and is treated as data, never as instructions.

What to look at first: attention items, changes since the previous visit, what is missing and the latest results.
Rules over the caller's own record; no model call. 404 if the patient is missing or denied.

A two-to-three sentence written summary of the brief. A model may rephrase the rule signals only; anything it adds
is discarded and the rule-made headline is used instead.

Items that deserve a look, by fixed rules: abnormal or moving results, new medicines or diagnoses, an emergency
visit, findings and reports waiting. Each names its source record.
What changed since a starting point, grouped as medication, lab, diagnosis, visit, note and document.

What is missing, by fixed rules: usual follow-up results not seen lately, medicines with no indexed label,
no allergy information. Never a statement that the patient is fine.
The stored written summary (markdown) with when it was written, or `exists=false` before the first one.

post.description:
Write the summary again from the record as it is now (about ten seconds) and replace the stored one. Every number
in it is checked against the record; if the model is unavailable a rule-made summary is stored and labelled so.

get.description: Everything waiting on the caller across the patients they are entitled to, most urgent first. No AI call.
Counts for the navigation badge and the dashboard.

post.description: Mark an abnormal result as reviewed so it leaves the pending list. A doctor's act; repeating is harmless.

get.description: Evidence the caller pinned to this patient's workspace.

post.description: Pin one evidence item from one of the caller's own answers. Repeats with the same key return the same pin.
Hide a patient from every screen. Nothing is deleted; restore brings them back.

get.description: Patients the caller archived (or is entitled to) and can restore.

post.description: Hide one record from every screen and read model. It stays in the history and can be restored.

get.description: The editable fields and current version of every record of one kind, for the edit forms.
Who changed what on this patient, newest first. Written by the database, never by the client.
Whether a recent change is still being reflected in the worklist, timeline and latest labs.

post.description:
Upload a PDF, PNG or JPEG report as the raw request body (set `X-Filename`). It is read in the background: what
is read is staged for a doctor, never written to the record. The same file twice returns the first upload.

get.description: The report, the rows read from it (each with the exact words and page it came from) and the page text.
The original file, streamed after an entitlement check. No link to it is ever handed out.

put.description: Correct what was read from a report row. A lab needs a supported test and a collection time.

post.description: Accept or reject one row, or put it back to waiting. Only a doctor decides; nothing is written until approval.

Write the accepted and edited rows to the record, each tagged with this report as its source. A report whose
printed name does not match the patient needs `confirm_identity`.
Reject the whole report: nothing from it is written.

get.description:
The closest of the caller's own patients to this one, each with the reasons. For comparison only; a ranking
aid, never a prediction or a recommendation. Only patients the caller can already open can appear.
Decisions recorded on this patient's review statements, open ones first.

post.description: Raise a finding from a statement in one of the caller's own answers. Repeating returns the same finding.

get.description: Other active users who have this patient: the people a finding can be escalated to.

patch.description: Acknowledge, flag (with a follow-up date), dismiss (with a reason) or escalate (to a colleague).

post.description: Run the safety review for one patient (the manual button). 404 if the patient is missing or denied.

200.description: Server-sent events: route, step, action, answer, refusal, error, done

post.description: Route a free-text request and stream the result. The router sees no patient data; the server re-checks everything.

200.description: Server-sent events: route, step, action, answer, refusal, error, done

post.description: Execute one allowlisted action under your own session. Anything else is refused, and the refusal is audited.

Write a change the assistant prepared, after the clinician approved its preview. Same service, same checks and
audit as the manual screen. Doctors only; someone else's or an expired proposal is 404.
Drop a prepared change. Nothing was written.

get.description:
The Why? panel: patient records, the SQL that ran and source sections. Only the asker, and only while still
entitled to the patient, can read an answer's evidence; anything else is the standard not found.

Label search with a full citation on every result. Brand names and small typos resolve to the generic.

Give `q`, a `drug`, or both. A drug without `q` lists that drug's sections. `section` takes a heading in any case,
or a word from it ("warnings").
Snapshot date, counts and the drugs in the index. The corpus is a controlled snapshot, not a live feed.
Every indexed drug with its Indian brands and section count, for browsing and filtering.

post.description: Ask for a drug that is not indexed. Nothing is indexed by asking: an admin decides and adds the label.

get.description: What the corpus covers and does not, and which unlabelled medicines are in use among the admin's own patients.

patch.description: Mark a request added (after running the setup script) or declined, with a note.

get.description: The latest stored golden run with every question's result, and earlier runs. Admins only.

post.description: Preview a saved view or visit brief. Nothing is stored (P1).
Save an approved preview. `approved` must be true; the agent can never save on its own.

get.description: The caller's own entries, newest first. Denied attempts are included.

What the assistant did for the caller over the last days: volume, routes, models, tools chosen, how long people
waited (median and 95th percentile) and the slowest steps. The caller's own entries only.

post.description: Create an invitation. The link is emailed (when email is configured) and returned once; only its hash is stored.

patch.description: Rename, grant or remove admin, disable or re-enable. Disabling ends the user's sessions.

post.description: A one-time link that lets the user set a new password. Their sessions end now.

put.description: Replace the user's patient set. Assistants may only have their supervising doctor's patients.

action.title: Action
action.description: One of open_patient, show_timeline, run_safety_review, pin_evidence.

AiMetrics.title: AiMetrics
AiMetrics.description:
The assistant's own activity for the caller over a window (basic observability): volume, routes, models, tools,
how long people waited, and which steps were slowest.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.

confirm_identity.title: Confirm Identity
confirm_identity.description: Needed when the name on the report does not match this patient: the doctor confirms it is theirs.

queued.title: Queued
queued.description: Rows being written to the record now; the report page shows them as approved.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.

last_answer_id.title: Last Answer Id
last_answer_id.description: The previous answer in this conversation. Its drug and lab names (a closed vocabulary, never free text) help the planner resolve words like 'that medicine'.

history.title: History
history.description: The last two user questions (text only).

AskRequest.title: AskRequest
AskRequest.description:
Free text from the command bar or agent panel. Only this is routed. `patient_id` is the open patient and is
never trusted as proof of access.

AskResult.title: AskResult
AskResult.description: JSON mode (Accept: application/json): the final outcome of a request that would otherwise stream.

BriefResponse.title: BriefResponse
BriefResponse.description: The first screen of a patient: what to look at, what changed, what is missing. Rules only, no model call.

generated_by.title: Generated By
generated_by.default: rules over the dashboard data, no model call

nlem_known.title: Nlem Known
nlem_known.description: Known drugs flagged as on the National List of Essential Medicines.

not_indexed.title: Not Indexed
not_indexed.description: Known drugs with no label indexed (a US label is not available or not added).

unlabelled_in_use.title: Unlabelled In Use
unlabelled_in_use.description: Medicines on active lists with no linked label, most used first, among the patients the caller can see.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.

DoctorRef.title: DoctorRef
DoctorRef.description: The doctor behind a record, and how we know: who entered it, who wrote the note, or the visit's clinician.

already_open.title: Already Open
already_open.description: This drug was already requested by you and is still open.

FindingCreate.title: FindingCreate
FindingCreate.description: Raise a finding from one statement of one of the caller's own answers.

FindingUpdate.title: FindingUpdate
FindingUpdate.description: A decision. Dismissing needs a reason, flagging needs a follow-up date, escalating needs a colleague.

HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse
HealthResponse.description: Liveness only. No configuration, no credentials (NFR-08).

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: Names of the fields that changed, for an update.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.

embedding.title: Embedding
embedding.description: How alike the two case descriptions are (0 to 1).

age.title: Age
age.description: How close the ages are (0 to 1).

description.title: Description
description.description: The medicine as written: a generic or an Indian brand. It is matched to the knowledge base.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.

description.title: Description
description.description: The medicine as written: a generic or an Indian brand. It is matched to the knowledge base.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.

OtpChallenge.title: OtpChallenge
OtpChallenge.description: Returned instead of a session when sign-in needs the emailed code.

treating_doctors.title: Treating Doctors
treating_doctors.description: Doctors who currently have this patient.

confirm_duplicate.title: Confirm Duplicate
confirm_duplicate.description: Set after the clinician confirms a same-name, same-birth-date patient is new.

PatientSummary.title: PatientSummary
PatientSummary.description: The stored written summary (markdown) of a patient, or `exists=false` before the first one is written.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.

overdue.title: Overdue
overdue.description: A follow-up whose date has passed (against the as-of date).

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The record behind the item, for the evidence link.

ProposalResult.title: ProposalResult
ProposalResult.description: An approved proposal: where the new record is.

rows_waiting.title: Rows Waiting
rows_waiting.description: Rows a doctor has not yet approved or rejected.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.description: This exact file was already uploaded for this patient.

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: unmatched_test, unmatched_drug, no_date, duplicate (already in the record), already_listed.

rows_waiting.title: Rows Waiting
rows_waiting.description: Rows a doctor has not yet approved or rejected.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.description: This exact file was already uploaded for this patient.

RowEdit.title: RowEdit
RowEdit.description: Replace what was read from a report row. A lab needs a supported test (its LOINC code) and a collection time.

ShareRequest.title: ShareRequest
ShareRequest.description: Email one summary of this patient to one recipient.

score.title: Score
score.description: The blended match, 0 to 1. A ranking aid, not a probability.

why.title: Why
why.description: The reasons, in words, taken from real records.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: False while this patient's case vector is still being built after a change.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: True while the worklist, timeline and latest labs are still catching up with a recent change.

TokenPair.title: TokenPair
TokenPair.description: Bearer tokens for the mobile client. The web client never receives these; it gets cookies.

approved.title: Approved
approved.description: Must be true; nothing is saved without approval (FR-22).

version.title: Version
version.description: The version last read. A stale one is refused with 409.
